limitations: Channel-to-sample map comes from the published Figure 2a image (read visually), not from a deposited file; replicate numbering within a group is by channel order and arbitrary
The PRIDE deposit has no sample/label description file; the 33 GB .pdResult was not read
LUM_02527.raw header unreadable (empty directory on FTP); fraction 77 inferred by elimination

The 6 ACN-step runs (LUM_02346-02351) and 2 PTMScan runs are not described in the paper beyond 'all acquisitions searched together'; which PTMScan kit (MMA or SDMA) was used for each is unknown; fractionation method for ACN-step runs not available
Technical replicate numbers 1-6 separate fractionation/LC series of one pooled sample (annotation convention, not stated by authors)
MS3 HCD quantification step is not representable in the single dissociation column; MS1 resolution/cycle time differ between EvoSep and other methods
Cleavage agent repeated column added by post-build duplication because the template contract does not mark it multiple
parse_sdrf cache-only error for study sample (PRIDE:0001013) is a known artifact
Cellosaurus CVCL_0006 age/sex/disease from local curated subset only; disease overridden by paper (AML), Cellosaurus accession not re-checked online
